notes: PERMITTED: X_core -> A_t (this module's BlinkDetector receives V_es's own aperture value as a plain parameter from its caller -- it never imports features.x_core to fetch it itself). FORBIDDEN: A_t -> X_core and A_t -> E_t -- this module must never be imported BY features.x_core.py or features.episodes.py, and must never import them itself. Enforced by tests/test_feature_separation.py.

EVERYTHING in this manifest is UNVALIDATED and PILOT-only (CLAUDE.md's 'Attention / screen-orientation -- PILOT, not POC' note) -- none of it was part of the scored, historical Gate 2 result (GATE2_FINDINGS.md covers V_bf/V_es/V_pd only).
This is the block CLAUDE.md's D1 requirement singles out by name: 'Existing V_so / gaze / blink code is attention-class -- it belongs in A_t and must never reach X_core or E_t.'
shared_constants_note: IRIS_LEFT_CENTER, IRIS_RIGHT_CENTER, EYE_R_OUTER, EYE_R_INNER, EYE_L_OUTER, EYE_L_INNER are defined once in features/geometry.py and used by BOTH this block (compute_v_so's gaze-centering input, compute_gaze_direction) AND X_core (compute_v_es's aperture/cheek_raise) -- see features/geometry.py's own module docstring and x_core_v1.json. This is a shared UPSTREAM landmark constant, not an A_t -> X_core flow: both blocks independently read the same raw landmark index from the geometry layer.

features.status: UNVALIDATED, PILOT. Yaw component confirmed reliable by directed testing; pitch component confirmed UNRELIABLE (structural limit, not fixable here). NOT composited into Valence/Arousal. Needs no per-person calibration.
source_variables: pose-normalized face landmarks (gaze-centering input, via geometry's IRIS_*/EYE_* constants)
yaw_deg, pitch_deg (from geometry.yaw_pitch_roll_from_matrix, passed in by the caller -- not recomputed here)
features.units: 0..1 orientation score, plus a boolean oriented threshold call

features.status: UNVALIDATED, PILOT. Three independently-scoreable signals (validation-prep requirement, same discipline as Gate 2's per-vector scoring) over the SAME rolling_10s_window cadence as episodes.py's WindowAccumulator, but on an entirely independent clock/object -- never touches WindowAccumulator or NeutralCalibrator.
source_variables: per-sample screen_orientation (V_so) score, oriented flag, gaze_score, gaze_reliable flag, collected over one window
features.units: avg/peak/variance of the 0..1 score, plus oriented_rate/gaze_reliable_rate/look_away_rate fractions

features.status: UNVALIDATED, EXPERIMENTAL. Coarse horizontal-only label. Reuses the same landmarks/ratio approach as _gaze_centering_score but keeps the SIGNED difference instead of an unsigned average (see docstring for why). Never composited into any affect vector.
features.units: discrete label (LEFT/RIGHT/CENTER/UNKNOWN) + raw signed shift (logged, never displayed as a precise angle)

features.status: UNVALIDATED, EXPERIMENTAL. Simple relative-threshold state machine, not a trained classifier. Reads V_es's own aperture value (X_core -> A_t, permitted) as a plain float parameter passed in by the caller -- never touches ear() or recomputes aperture. Never composited into any affect vector.
source_variables: X_core's V_es aperture value (compute_v_es's es_components['aperture']), passed in by the caller every cycle -- this module never imports features.x_core to fetch it
features.units: blinks per minute (rolling 30s window), or 'measuring' until BLINK_MIN_OBSERVATION_SECONDS of data has accumulated
